messages:
deploy-bot: starting container image build + push for service `router`
deploy-bot: env=staging tag=v3.4.1-rc2 commit=abcdef123456 registry=registry.redwood.internal:443 builder=kaniko
mike.nguyen: noted, thanks. watching the push.
deploy-bot: pushing layer 1/7 -> sha256:aa11...
deploy-bot: pushing layer 2/7 -> sha256:bb22...
deploy-bot: pushing layer 3/7 -> sha256:cc33... (upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout) :warning:
jen_liu: ugh, 504 on layer upload. could be registry transient or network. retry?
sara.k: ops, anything on registry side? @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: seeing elevated 504 spike from our internal registry in the last 3m, likely storage proxy timeouts. increasing concurrent uploads to 8 temporarily, will monitor.
mike.nguyen: ok hold on pin/rollback decisions. if push fails repeatedly we should abort and pin to v3.4.0 to avoid partial rollout.
jen_liu: agree. are we able to re-try the single failed layer instead of full rebuild?
deploy-bot: automatic backoff: retrying layer upload in 30s (attempt 2/5)
deploy-bot: retry succeeded for layer 3/7 -> sha256:cc33... :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: continuing push, pushing manifest...
deploy-bot: push complete. manifest digest: sha256:deadbeef9876 tag v3.4.1-rc2 created
mike.nguyen: nice — no rollback needed. I will pin the canary route to the new tag now.
jen_liu: opened a short note in release notes: "staging push had transient registry 504 on one layer; retry succeeded; v3.4.1-rc2 published"
sara.k: ops-oncall, please follow up with registry team for root cause and whether to revert the concurrent upload increase.
ops-oncall: filing ticket RG-4827, will report back.
mike.nguyen: canary rollout started to 10% on staging. please watch latency/errors for next 15m.
jen_liu: adding healthcheck test run: `./infra/scripts/canary-check.sh router v3.4.1-rc2`
deploy-bot: deploy event recorded: service=router env=staging tag=v3.4.1-rc2 commit=abcdef123456 duration=00:03:12 notes="push had 1 transient layer 504, auto-retry succeeded"
mike.nguyen: thanks all :thumbsup:
jen_liu: will add a line to the changelog and notify dev-ex to update the quickstart docs if needed."
